articles.title: What is the 'political firewall' against Germany's far-right AfD?
articles.summary: Germany's centrist parties reject any cooperation with the Alternative for Germany (AfD), parts of which are classified as right-wing extremist. However, this policy is coming under increasing pressure.

articles.title: Search resumes for 22 crew after cargo ship sinks off India
articles.summary: The Panama‑flagged Ocean Winner had 24 people on board when it sank in the Bay of Bengal. The ship is thought to have been carrying iron ore from India to Singapore.

articles.title: Trump hits out at Canada over retaliatory tariffs
articles.summary: Donald Trump has accused Canada of treating US farmers unfairly for years as a trade standoff between Ottawa and Washington escalates. Both sides are threatening new tariffs after the collapse of talks on Friday.
